about.metaDescription: Why Dream Weaver exists: a dream journal created by Felipe Casali, connected to the families who care for people with Alzheimer's.
about.title: A dream journal with a reason behind it
about.p1: Dream Weaver began with a family story. Felipe Casali's father was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease at 65. Watching memory slip away, and seeing how heavy the emotional and financial load is for caregivers, changed what Felipe wanted to build.
about.p2: During an MBA in Artificial Intelligence and Big Data at the University of São Paulo, he found in AI a way to connect technology with memory and reflection. Dream Weaver is the result: a place to record your inner stories, look at them from different angles, and keep them.
about.impactBody: Part of the subscription revenue is committed to families and institutions caring for people with Alzheimer's. Before any amount is announced, we will publish who receives it and how it is accounted for, here on this page.
